Export your favorites, reading positions, deed history, tasbih and make-up prayer counters, and prayer and alert settings to a file, then import them on another device. Nothing is sent to any server, and the backup does not include voice files.
The app holds the daily deeds, the complete Holy Quran, the complete Tafsir al-Mizan, the complete Mafatih al-Jinan, the complete al-Sahifa al-Sajjadiyya, prayer times, the qibla and the calendar.
Text of the Holy Quran: the Tanzil project (tanzil.net), Hafs narration in the Uthmani script.

Mafatih al-Jinan by Shaykh Abbas al-Qummi, al-Sahifa al-Sajjadiyya of Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS), and al-Mizan fi Tafsir al-Quran by Allamah Sayyid Muhammad Husayn Tabatabai: texts adapted from the OpenITI corpus, from the digitisations of al-Maktaba al-Shamela, rafed.net and altafsir.com.

Changes: the texts were split into the sections the app shows, OpenITI markup was converted or removed, verses quoted in al-Mizan were put between ornate brackets, and page numbers were kept as markers. Not a letter of al-Mizan was removed, and no word was altered or abridged.

The two bundled adhan recordings (the shrine of Imam Husayn in Karbala and the shrine of Imam Rida in Mashhad) were provided by the project owner, who confirmed they are free of licence restrictions; the muezzin is not named in either file. Silence was trimmed from the start of the Karbala adhan and the end of the Mashhad adhan, loudness was normalised, and both were encoded as Opus. Details in docs/licenses/ADHAN_AUDIO.md.

Khums is twenty percent of what remains of the year’s profits from work, trade and other gains after the year’s expenses.
The year starts with your first earnings; a fixed date each year, called the khums year start, may be used.
Khums is split in two halves, the share of the Imam (AJ) and the share of the sadat, and is paid to the marja or his authorised agent.

This tool estimates the surplus by the general rule and is not a fatwa. What counts as expenses, and how debts and invested money are treated, differ between maraji; check with your marja’s office or agent before paying. No money is paid through the app.
